resolution.question: Will at least one member of Riverton's parks committee vote against the skate-park relocation when it comes up at Thursday's session?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least one committee member voted against the skate-park relocation during Thursday's session. Resolve NO if the session concludes with no vote against (i.e., all votes are in favor or the vote does not occur). If the session does not occur by the cutoff, resolve NO.
